# Phase 3 — calibration

*Generated by `hydrocascade rootcause` on 2026-09-17.*

> ### ⚠ Fitted on synthetic data
>
> `data_mode` is `synthetic` for `era5_land`, `glofas`, `imd`, `imerg`, and 9,764 of
> 9,765 catalog rows are synthetic stand-ins. **Every number in this report describes
> the stand-in generators, not Kerala.** They are here to show the procedure runs end
> to end and that the diagnostics fire. Switching `data_mode` to `real` and rerunning
> `hydrocascade rootcause` turns all of them into results with no code change.


Doc 06 §6 makes this a hard requirement, and the reason is mechanical: `S_i(u)` is a **multiplier** inside `mu_i(u,t)`. A score that ranks perfectly but sits 40% too high leaves every ranking untouched and corrupts every intensity, probability and alert threshold downstream. Discrimination and calibration are different properties.

Calibration is fitted on the **held-out spatial folds only** — fitting it on training predictions would calibrate the model to its own memorised answers.

| hazard | stage | method | ECE before | ECE after | MCE before | MCE after |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| landslide | S-dynamic | isotonic | 0.0840 | 0.0096 | 0.3469 | 1.0000 |
| landslide | S-static (exported) | isotonic | 0.1157 | 0.0100 | 0.4384 | 0.6260 |
| flood | S-dynamic | isotonic | 0.1515 | 0.0024 | 0.3173 | 0.0230 |
| flood | S-static (exported) | isotonic | 0.2986 | 0.0000 | 0.4658 | 0.0000 |

`S_L(u)` and `S_F(s)` are exported to `data/processed/S_landslide.parquet` and `S_flood.parquet` as calibrated probabilities strictly inside (0,1) — a zero there would make a unit permanently impossible, which no terrain justifies. This file is the interface contract between Part 1 and Part 2.
